layer_description: Theobald gHM v3 cumulative human footprint 0-1; used inverted as intactness (1 - gHM). Project pulls a Y2Y-clipped GEE asset (~90 m).
Pither et al. 2023 Circuitscape current density (~300 m, amperes); higher = stronger predicted movement.
Carroll et al. 2018 current-flow centrality between current & future climate analogs (~5 km).
Carroll 2023 (AdaptWest) backward climatic velocity (km/yr), 8-GCM ensemble SSP5-8.5 2071-2100; used inverted (vmax - v) -> refugia.
Biomass pool, t C/ha. Project layer attributed to Berman & McDowell (derivation of the global product).
Mineral-soil organic carbon pool, t C/ha. Project layer attributed to Berman & McDowell.
Lumbierres et al. 2022 Area-of-Habitat richness - mammals, all species (~100 m).
Lumbierres et al. 2022 Area-of-Habitat richness - birds, all species (~100 m).
IUCN Global Ecosystem Typology Level-3 EFGs; 40 Y2Y-present groups each down-weighted (group counts like one theme). Source encodes 1=major, 2=minor; pipeline swaps to major=2/minor=1.
Subsoil organic carbon pool, t C/ha; prepared but currently excluded from the optimization. Berman & McDowell.
